components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors

          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true

      title: Specialty

      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true

          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name

      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized to
            E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped; a leading '+' with
            its country code is kept, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a
            single leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must be
            a '+' followed by 8 to 15 digits, and is stored and returned in that form.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
            Optional; when omitted on create it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-time directive only. When true, allows creating this owner even though
            another owner already has the same lastName and address (they share a household);
            otherwise such a duplicate is rejected with 409 Conflict. Not stored or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where LAST3 is the
                upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a global 4-digit
                zero-padded sequence equal to one more than the current number of owners.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the
                last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable shared identifier for the owner's household. Assigned when the owner
                is created with sharesHousehold=true to join an existing owner who has the same
                lastName and address; every owner in that household shares the same value.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-3F9A2C7B1D4E'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created,
                already shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipTier:
              title: Membership tier
              description: >-
                The owner's membership tier. 'SILVER' when namesakeCount is 0 and an email

              type: string
              enum:

              readOnly: true
            locality:

              description: >-

                city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## Summary

Implemented the `bulkSignupWarning` flag on the owner response.

**What the spec needed:** when more than 80 owners have already been created "today" (i.e. share the relevant registration date, excluding the owner itself), the response should carry `bulkSignupWarning: true`; otherwise `false`. The acceptance test reads the field back via `GET /api/owners/{id}`, so it had to be present on every owner response, not just the create path.

**Changes:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — added a `bulkSignupWarning` boolean (readOnly) property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field.

2. **`src/main/java/.../mapper/OwnerMapper.java`** — this is where the existing derived response fields already live (`displayName`, `initials`, `membershipTier`, `locality`), so it's the natural home. Converted the mapper from an interface to an abstract class (the project uses `defaultComponentModel=spring`, so it's a Spring bean) and injected `ClinicService`. Added a `bulkSignupWarning(owner)` helper mapped via expression that counts owners sharing the owner's `registrationDate`, excluding the owner itself, and returns `true` when that count exceeds 80.

**Design notes:**
- Excluding the owner by id means that on a create the count reflects the owners that *already* existed that day (mirroring the `> 80 already created` wording), and it stays consistent when the same owner is later fetched via GET.
- This reuses the same per-day accumulation the existing daily-limit rule enforces against (`DAILY_OWNER_LIMIT = 100`), so the warning at 80 fires before the hard reject at 100, and the flag is uniform across the create, single-GET, and list/page responses.
- Returns `false` for owners with no registration date; no dependency cycle since `ClinicService` doesn't depend on any mapper.
